{{Quote|My daughter, Dera, has become obsesed with some Tusken Raiders that recently took up residence in a nearby cave.|[[Huff Darklighter]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DE" />}}
The '''Tusken Cave''' was a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Located close to the [[Darklighter family/Legends|Darklighter family's]] [[Darklighter estate|estate]], the cave was populated by the indigenous [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] known as Tusken Raiders.

==History==
{{Quote|The Tusken Raiders in that cave over yonder are a threat to this area. I need you to deal with them. And by that, I mean eliminate them.|[[Dera Darklighter]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DE" />}}
The Tusken Raiders had only recently took up residence in the cave of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="SWG:DE" />

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] visited the cave by the time of the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Tatooine]]. He fought Tusken Raiders along with the dangerous creatures, including [[Sandfly/Legends|sand flies]] and [[Sand Slug|sand slugs]], who inhabited the cave.<ref name="SWNES">[[Star Wars (1991 video game)|''Star Wars'' video game (1991)]]</ref>

[[File:TuskenCave2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Tusken Cave, with the Darklighter estate in the distance]]
Located nearby the [[Darklighter estate]], [[Dera Darklighter]], the daughter of [[Huff Darklighter]], subsequently became obsessed with the Tusken Raiders who began inhabiting the cave.<ref name="SWG:DE" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> she set out into the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] to investigate the situation, much to the chagrin of her father who feared for her safety. In order to make sure she was all right, Huff tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with locating his daughter. The spacer did locate Dera, who only expressed annoyance at her father's lack of trust in her abilities. Nonetheless, Dera wished to use the spacer's skills to eliminate the Tuskens in the cave, as they posed a threat to the area.<ref name="SWG:DE" />

[[File:TuskenCave3.jpg|250px|thumb|The interior of the Tusken Cave]]
The Tuskens who inhabited the cave were especially vile. The spacer agreed to help the young woman, and eliminated at least two dozen Tusken Flesh Renders and [[Blood/Legends|Blood]] Hunters. However, in order to slow the Tusken Raider attacks sufficiently enough until a strong force could be brought against them, the vile Tusken [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] would need to be eliminated. Ultimately, he too was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the superior expertise of the spacer. With the Tusken threat diminished, Dera was assured that they would be slowed down enough until a larger fighting force could finish them off completely.<ref name="SWG:DE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tusken Cave was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Tusken Cave was added to the game as part of the revamped [[W:c:swg:Darklighter's Estate questline|Darklighter's Estate questline]],<ref name="SWG:DE" /> introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
